hebrewText: וְ/הַ/מְשֹֽׁרֲרִ֨ים בְּנֵי אָסָ֜ף עַל מַעֲמָדָ֗/ם כְּ/מִצְוַ֤ת דָּוִיד֙ וְ/אָסָ֞ף וְ/הֵימָ֤ן וִֽ/ידֻתוּן֙ חוֹזֵ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִ֖ים לְ/שַׁ֣עַר וָ/שָׁ֑עַר אֵ֣ין לָ/הֶ֗ם לָ/סוּר֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל עֲבֹֽדָתָ֔/ם כִּֽי אֲחֵי/הֶ֥ם הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם הֵכִ֥ינוּ לָ/הֶֽם

tokens.bdb: to sing
tokens.kjv: behold (by mistake for H7789 (שׁוּר)), sing(-er, -ing man, -ing woman).

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: (figuratively) a position
a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)
David, the youngest son of Jesse
tokens.explanation: David — Davi, rei de Israel, autor de muitos salmos

tokens.bdb: Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first
Heman, the name of at least two Israelites
Jeduthun, an Israelite
a beholder in vision; also a compact (as looked upon with approval)
tokens.kjv: agreement, prophet, see that, seer, (star-) gazer.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a beholder in vision; also a compact
tokens.enLiteralWord: a beholder in vision; also a compact
tokens.explanation: a beholder in vision; also a compact
tokens.explanationEn: a beholder in vision; also a compact

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.bdb: a janitor
an opening, i.e. door or gate
an opening, i.e. door or gate
a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: to turn off (literal or figurative)
tokens.kjv: be(-head), bring, call back, decline, depart, eschew, get (you), go (aside), [idiom] grievous, lay away (by), leave undone, be past, pluck away, put (away, down), rebel, remove (to and fro), revolt, [idiom] be sour, take (away, off), turn (aside, away, in), withdraw, be without.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: work of any kind
tokens.kjv: act, bondage, [phrase] bondservant, effect, labour, ministering(-try), office, service(-ile, -itude), tillage, use, work, [idiom] wrought.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
tokens.kjv: another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'.

tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.explanation: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.explanationEn: a Levite or descendant of Levi

tokens.bdb: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
tokens.kjv: certain(-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-) stablish, stand, tarry, [idiom] very deed.
